rows.grounds: numeral element forming quantity with following noun
locative indicating extent or domain of quantity
compound denoting devices or mechanisms of birth
describes beings subjected to suffering in that domain

items.question: What condition afflicts beings within the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms?
premises: The domain comprises eighty-four thousand units.
These units are womb-mechanisms of birth.
items.inference: Beings are subjected to torment throughout the vast multiplicity of womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is implied from context rather than explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
